summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Kaspi.kz, a Kazakh private issuer, solely to furnish a notice of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders. The agenda includes approval of a dividend of 850 KZT per share, appointment of a counting commission, and other routine items. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard corporate governance notice with no special-situation catalyst.
